applies_to: CAREL gaSteam UG gas-fired isothermal steam humidifiers (indoor and outdoor versions, single unit or Main/Secondary pairs).
summary: gaSteam is CAREL's gas-fired steam humidifier with a built-in controller and web server. BACnet MS/TP (on the BMS RS485 port) and BACnet IP (on the Ethernet port) are built in; only one of the two can be active at a time. The object list covers set points, probe readings, production, burner and fan data, scheduler settings, Main/Secondary data and one BV per alarm.
notes: The manual marks every object RW, including readings and alarm flags; treat probe readings, status and alarm objects as read-only in practice.

Objects ending in _Secondary or _S, and the NetStatus/Alrm_NetUnit objects, only carry data in Main/Secondary or networked installations; the third burner/fan objects (_3, MB_3) apply to the largest models.
Analog engineering units are listed in SI (°C, kg/h); the UoM object (PIV 29) switches between international and imperial units.
Status objects marked with a footnote in the manual (UnitStatus, NetStatus, fan status) carry the state codes shown in the states column.
Source table: 15.1.3 'Table of Bacnet variables', manual pages 107-113 (350 objects).

source.title: gaSteam - UG Gas-fired humidifier - User manual

integration.summary: Enable BACnet on the Ethernet port (Eh06, on by default) or on the BMS port (Eh01 protocol BACnet plus Eh03), and set the device instance on Eh04. Then enable On/Off and control from supervisor on Eh07/Eh08. Start and stop the unit with OnBySV (BV 0) and send the production request on SV_PwrReq (AV 73), or let the unit run its own humidity control with the set point on AV 1. Monitor OnOffStatus, UnitStatus, current production and the alarm summary BVs.
integration.enable: On screens Eh07/Eh08 (Installer menu) select the supervisor port and enable 'On/Off signal from supervisor' and 'control from supervisor'; on the BMS port the Eh01 settings 'On/Off from SV' and 'Control from SV' do the same. Without them the unit ignores the supervisor on/off and production request.
integration.heartbeat: Eh08 can enable a supervisor-offline alarm (ALP21, BV 135) with an activation delay. The manual does not say what the unit does with its output when the supervisor goes offline.
integration.remote_sensors: With control from supervisor the BMS sends the production request on SV_PwrReq (AV 73) instead of the unit using a probe. Up to four CAREL wireless probes can also feed the unit (WirelessPrbVal AI objects).
setup: BACnet MS/TP on the BMS port: Eh03 sets the MAC address (default 0), max masters (127) and max info frames (10); Eh02 sets the baud rate (default 19200).
For BACnet MS/TP the manual says to set Eh06 as well as Eh03 (BACnet on the Ethernet port is enabled by default).
BACnet IP on the Ethernet port is enabled by default on Eh06; the unit's default IP is 192.168.0.1/24 with DHCP off (Eh05).
Only one BACnet instance exists, so BACnet cannot run on the BMS port and the Ethernet port at the same time.
gotchas: Every object is listed RW; don't write to readings, status or alarm objects.
Scheduler, probe range and drain settings (AV 15-29, PIV 10-28, BV 161-166) are configuration; avoid cyclic writes.
SV_Command (PIV 36) resets alarms (1) or cylinder hours (2); it is a one-shot command, not a value to hold.
